title: Flow memory
description: A metallic surface remembers the currents drawn across it as color and refraction.
useCase: Explore a persistent fluid gesture whose velocity continues to transport the material.
interaction: Move across the surface to stir it.
reducedMotion: The simulation clock stops; deliberate pointer or keyboard input produces a finite still update.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; static fallback when unavailable. A bounded 64×64 CPU velocity/dye solver with 12 pressure iterations rendered through a WebGL texture, not GPU compute.
look: Full-bleed silver-grey embossed leather texture with faint lime-green tinted swirls, above a dark green footer bar with a lime slider and outlined button.
motion: Moving the pointer injects velocity and lime dye into a 64×64 fluid grid that keeps advecting, warping the leather texture as currents drift and dye fades at the set dissipation.
adapt: The CPU solver `step` runs on a `GRID` × `GRID` field and `inject` adds pointer velocity and dye; the fragment shader displaces `u_image` by `u_flow` and mixes a lime tint. Swap `silver-leather.webp`, tune `decay` and the splat force, and keep `fm-fallback`.
